6.description: [Pending Restart] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] [C'thun] Correction - Health changes to Giant Eye Tentacle, Giant Claw Tentacle and Flesh Tentacle only apply to Ascended Difficulty. Health Base Flex Scaling has been reduced by 23%. The creatures Base Creature Health has been increased to compensate. This means for 10 player there will be no change. For any number above 10 player there will be a health reduction of 3.6% from the creatures Base Health per additional player or a total of 54% health reduction from the creatures Base Health at 25 player (about 600K health less for Giant Eyes and Claws or 400K for Flesh Tentacles).

6.description: [Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Original Recipes from Ruins and Temple of Ahn'Qiraji once again use their vanilla materials. The upgraded versions use the original TBC materials.

[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Recipes that originally drop from either Ruins or Temple of Ahn'Qiraji and at a later patch have been moved to one of the TBC reputation vendor such as Enchant Cloak - Subtlety now have a equal or better version available from their respective TBC vendors. Player that had the reputation to obtain those recipes can now purchase the upgraded version from the respective vendor. Upgraded enchants are, Formula: Enchant Cloak - Superior Subtlety, Formula: Enchant Cloak - Superior Stealth, Formula: Enchant Gloves - Greater Threat, Formula: Enchant Cloak - Superior Dodge.
[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Vethera inside the Temple of Ahn'Qiraji will now exchange a combination of Scarabs and Idols for Shoulder Enchantments.

[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Scarab Coffer now contain all items that can drop from trash creatures including scarabs, idols, recipes, mounts, epics etc at a higher chance. As bigger the coffer, as more loot it contains and as higher its drop rate.

[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Reworked the loot of all trash creatures inside the Temple of Ahn'Qiraji. Ahn'Qiraji Recipes now exclusively drop from trash. All trash creatures are now able to drop Scarabs, Idols, Mounts, Blessed Weapons (Previously boss bonus loot). Corrected multiple instances of trash epic items only dropping from a specific creature type. For example the Shard of the Fallen Star could only drop from 6 creatures inside the raid. All trash mobs can now drop every trash loot item, resulting in a drop chance increase of up to 5000% depending on the item.

[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] Most Large Scarab Coffers have been replaced with Small Scarab Coffers, Large Scarab Coffers can now be found near each boss. C'thun's room now has Master's Scarab Coffers.
[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] C'thun's room is now blocked of by a gate until all previous bosses have been slayn and that closes shortly after C'thun enter's combat.

[Pre-Release Patch Notes] [Temple of Ahn'Qiraji] The gate to the Twin Emperor's now requires all previous bosses to be slayn in order to open. The Twin Emperor's are now untargetable and will not enter player combat until all previous bosses have been slayn.

[Holy Ground] This gameplay will push the Enchant into a much more active playstyle while still offering a powerful group healing option. We will keep a close eye on the performance of Holy Ground and make the necessary adjustments to ensure this remains a strong Epic choice for healers.
[Holy Ground] Direct Heals cast on an ally standing in your Consecration now radiate out, healing up to 5 nearby allies for 5% of the healing done.
[Holy Ground] Allies standing inside your Consecration now receive 5% additional healing from you.

[Holy Ground] Holy Ground has been reworked. This Enchant offered passive power in a way that limited the creative options available when selecting your Epic Mystic Enchants in high end content as the ability to stack this Enchant and bypass mechanics made it a non-choice for certain encounters. This passive design did not fit Ascension's design values for Epic Enchants and has now been reworked to provide more active power to healers.

[Wind Slam] Shield of Righteousness can now trigger Wind Slam.
[Wind Slam] Updated to the new tooltip paradigm to be more clear how this enchant works.
[Stormgarde] Shield of Righteousness can now trigger Stormgarde.
